places: Which city did David capture and make his stronghold?
David took the strong hold of Zion: the same is the city of David.
Jerusalem becomes the City of David in the biblical narrative.
Where does Micah identify the coming ruler as coming from?
But thou, Bethlehem Ephratah... out of thee shall he come forth unto me that is to be ruler in Israel.
Which town is named as Jesus' dwelling place after the return from Egypt?
He came and dwelt in a city called Nazareth.
Which city did Jesus pass through before meeting Zacchaeus?
Jesus entered and passed through Jericho.
Luke locates this episode in Jericho.
Where was Paul waiting when he addressed the Athenians?
While Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was stirred in him.
Which city is named as a major stop after Athens?
After these things Paul departed from Athens, and came to Corinth.
Acts records Paul moving from Athens to Corinth.
journeys: Which place is part of Abram's route before Canaan?
Abram went forth... from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan.
Genesis connects Ur, Haran and the intended journey toward Canaan.
Why did Abram go down into Egypt?
There was a famine in the land: and Abram went down into Egypt.
Genesis gives famine as the immediate reason.
Which region is associated with Israel receiving manna?
Behold, I will rain bread from heaven for you.
Exodus records bread from heaven during the wilderness journey.
Which island is named after Paul's shipwreck?
When they were escaped, then they knew that the island was called Melita.
KJV uses Melita, commonly identified with Malta.
Which city follows Athens in Acts 18?
After these things Paul departed from Athens, and came to Corinth.
Paul departs Athens and comes to Corinth.
empires: Which empire carried Israel away after the fall of Samaria?
The king of Assyria took Samaria, and carried Israel away into Assyria.
2 Kings names Assyria as the deporting power.
He carried away Jehoiachin to Babylon.
The biblical text explicitly names Babylon.
Which ruler issues a decree connected with rebuilding in Jerusalem?
The LORD God of heaven... hath charged me to build him an house at Jerusalem.
Which Roman ruler is named in Luke 2?
There went out a decree from Caesar Augustus, that all the world should be taxed.
Luke names Caesar Augustus in the birth narrative setting.
Which king of Babylon is named at the start of Daniel?
Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came unto Jerusalem, and besieged it.
Daniel 1 names Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.
paul: Which city is described as a chief city of Macedonia in Acts 16?
From thence to Philippi, which is the chief city of that part of Macedonia.
Where did Paul and Silas go after Thessalonica?
The brethren immediately sent away Paul and Silas by night unto Berea.
Acts records their night departure to Berea.
Where did Paul speak from Mars' hill / the Areopagus?
Paul stood in the midst of Mars' hill, and said, Ye men of Athens.
How long did Paul remain teaching in Corinth according to Acts 18:11?
He continued there a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.
Which city did Paul come to in Acts 19:1?
Acts 19 centers on ministry in Ephesus.
Where does Acts 28:16 say Paul arrived?
When we came to Rome, the centurion delivered the prisoners.
Acts concludes the voyage with arrival in Rome.
churches: Which church is told it has left its first love?
Nevertheless I have somewhat against thee, because thou hast left thy first love.
The warning appears in Christ's message to Ephesus.
Which church is told to be faithful unto death?
Be thou faithful unto death, and I will give thee a crown of life.
This encouragement is addressed to Smyrna.
Which church is told, “I know thy works, and where thou dwellest”?
I know thy works, and where thou dwellest.
This is in the message to Pergamum.
Which church is told to be watchful?
Be watchful, and strengthen the things which remain.
The call to wakefulness belongs to Sardis.
Which church is said to have “a little strength”?
Thou hast a little strength, and hast kept my word.
The phrase appears in the message to Philadelphia.
Because thou art lukewarm... I will spue thee out of my mouth.
The lukewarm warning is addressed to Laodicea.
temple: What separated the Holy Place from the Most Holy Place?
The vail shall divide unto you between the holy place and the most holy.
Exodus explicitly describes the veil as the divider.
Which object was made for washing?
Thou shalt also make a laver of brass... to wash withal.
The laver is described as being for washing.
Which object is described in Exodus 27:1?
Thou shalt make an altar of shittim wood.
Exodus 27 opens with instructions for the altar.
Where does God say, “there I will meet with thee”?
There I will meet with thee, and I will commune with thee from above the mercy seat.
The verse connects the meeting place with the mercy seat.
What filled the tabernacle after it was set up?
Then a cloud covered the tent of the congregation, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.
Exodus describes the cloud and the glory filling the tabernacle.
